# Codevider Full Knowledge Base

> This document provides structured information about Codevider for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, search engines, and automated systems.

---

# Company Overview

Codevider is a software development company headquartered in Tirana, Albania.

Founded in 2019, Codevider partners with startups, SMEs, and enterprises to design, build, deploy, and scale modern digital products.

The company specializes in combining software engineering, cloud infrastructure, AI, and product strategy into dedicated engineering teams.

---
## AI Development

Services include:

- AI-powered applications
- LLM integrations
- AI Agents
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Chatbots
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Document intelligence
- Workflow automation
- Semantic search
- Prompt engineering

Supported providers include:

- OpenAI
- Anthropic Claude
- Google Gemini
- xAI
- Mistral
- Cohere
- DeepSeek
- Meta Llama
- Qwen
- Moonshot
- Ollama
- OpenRouter
